audience_context: Adults with aphasia. Requires extreme clarity, large readable typography, generous whitespace, dual-coding (icons + text), accessible contrast, and a calm but confident feel.
archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) + Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) hybrid. Friendly geometric simplicity matching Loom & Dropbox, with the premium accessibility of Speechify.

rules: Use fluid typography for headings, capping at text-5xl on desktop for hero sections.
Body text should be text-base or text-lg for high readability.
Leading should be loose (leading-relaxed) for body text to aid reading for users with aphasia.

layout_and_spacing.general: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-12 for standard sections to provide breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.hub_dashboard: Mode A Bento Grid. Asymmetric but heavily structured blocks. Rounded corners (rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl).
layout_and_spacing.borders: Soft, 1px solid strokes (border-gray-200) instead of blurry shadows for better cognitive boundary definition.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Left-align dense text and labels. Center align hero elements if concise.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow opacity.
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: High contrast ring-2 ring-indigo-500 ring-offset-2 for all interactive elements.
motion_and_interaction.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations must be purposeful (e.g., feedback on answers).

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Rounded, prominent. Minimum height 48px for motor accessibility.
components.cards: Cardless or subtle rounded surfaces (max 24px border-radius) with 1px border. Solid pastel backgrounds for categories.
components.icons: lucide-react. Must be paired with text for all major actions (dual-coding).
components.auth_inputs: Shadcn forms with large clickable areas. Clear, explicit error messages.

hero_image.description: Abstract 3D geometric composition of concentric circles and puzzle pieces in soft indigo and warm orange. To be used in the marketing landing page hero section.

community_image.description: Two happy adults having a conversation. To be used in the 'Features' or 'About' section to emphasize real-world functional communication.

testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
